decision.summary: Only one candidate temporary offset identified: a sharp U-dip (~590–610) lacking coherent N/E counterparts and an unambiguous return. The broader sustained N↑/E↓/U↓ trend (starting ~560) is interpreted as coherent long-term motion, not a temporary offset. No other intervals within [450,699] meet criteria for confirmed temporary offsets.

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp multi-sample dip from ~590 to 610, not mirrored in N or E; N and E continue their gradual trend (N rising, E falling) without corresponding inflection. Return to pre-dip U trajectory is ambiguous—U resumes declining but with no clear reversal edge; interior shape differs from surrounding trend. Cross-axis inconsistency and unobserved/uncertain return prevent confirmation.
